# MDL502 · `unknown-masquerade-function`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A masked column's value names no masking function of the version.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F10 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl502-unknown-masquerade-function-plaintext`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl502-unknown-masquerade-function-plaintext.txtar), [`mdl502-null-function-by-version`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl502-null-function-by-version.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper selects the masking function by the start of the value (`random_string`, `constant`, …; `null` only from v0.21.4-1). When none matches, it logs `Function not found: Using default`, visible only at `--verbose 3`, and uses its identity function: up to v0.21.2-4 the column is dumped unmasked, in plaintext; from v0.21.3-1 it is dumped empty. Either way the dump succeeds and looks normal.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`email`=radnom_string
`name`=
`phone`=null
```

```text
2:9-2:22 error MDL502[unknown-masquerade-function] `radnom_string` is not a masking function in v0.19.3-3: did you mean `random_string`?
  = mydumper dumps the column unmasked, in plaintext.
  fix (unsafe): Use `random_string`
3:1-3:7 error MDL502[unknown-masquerade-function] the masked column `name` has no masking function
  = mydumper dumps the column unmasked, in plaintext.
4:9-4:13 error MDL502[unknown-masquerade-function] `null` is not a masking function in v0.19.3-3
  = mydumper dumps the column unmasked, in plaintext.
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`email`=random_string
`name`=
`phone`=null
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL502: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL502` on the line above it.
